name: K7222 horizontal phase detector oscillator driver

horizontal_r41_r.rationale: Manual page 17 names thermistor R41, while annotated schematic page 3 labels the upper series thermistor R43. Their correspondence is provisional; no value is printed and the page-8 BOM omits R41. A 470-ohm nominal matches documented R13 in the bias chain; 100..2000 ohms brackets a broad effect. Fixed-temperature equivalent only.

horizontal_tank_l.rationale: Per half of T1. C16=100 nF and 16 kHz give a 0.989 mH ideal LC scale; the source-connected autonomous oscillator reaches 15.89 kHz at 1.45 mH with its documented R21/C15 and provisional transistor loading. The 1.2-2.1 mH range spans C16 tolerance and unresolved loading; it is not a measured T1 winding or a calibration freeze.

horizontal_tank_r.rationale: At 16 kHz and 1.45 mH, half-winding reactance is 146 ohm. A 0.1-5 ohm DC resistance budget gives an unloaded Q proxy of about 29-1458; the connected oscillator stage stays in the printed frequency range at the tested endpoints. Actual copper/core loss is unmeasured.

horizontal_tank_coupling.rationale: Unmeasured T1 half-winding coupling, independent of the separate T2 driver transformer.

horizontal_driver_coupling.rationale: Unmeasured T2 primary-to-secondary coupling, independent of the separate T1 oscillator winding.

horizontal_driver_l.rationale: At the documented 16 kHz line rate, primary reactance must exceed five times the documented R23=62 ohm feed resistance, giving L>=3.08 mH. The 3.1-20 mH range and 5 mH nominal are operating candidates, not original T2 measurements.

horizontal_driver_r.rationale: A 6.2 ohm upper bound adds at most 10% to documented R23=62 ohm series loss at equal primary current. Original T2 copper/core loss is unknown.

horizontal_choke_r.rationale: L1 copper-resistance budget: its added DC drop is limited to 10% of documented series R42=6.8 ohm, giving 0.68 ohm maximum. The 0.05-0.68 ohm range and 0.5 ohm nominal are functional candidates, not original winding measurements.

horizontal_choke_l.rationale: Documented C22=220 uF and 16 kHz line rate give 11.2 uH minimum for an LC corner no higher than one fifth of line frequency. The 100 uH nominal puts that corner at 1.07 kHz; 12 uH-1 mH bounds are exploratory and core loss remains unmodeled.

horizontal_linearity_r.rationale: L3's 1 ohm maximum is below 2% of documented parallel R35=82 ohm, preserving an inductive-dominated branch at DC. Original copper and core loss are unknown.

horizontal_linearity_l.rationale: At the 16 us retrace half-cycle frequency and documented parallel R35=82 ohm +/-5%, the 95 uH maximum keeps worst-case R35 current below one quarter of L3 current; 20 uH nominal and 1 uH lower bound are exploratory candidates, not factory measurements.

horizontal_compensation_r.rationale: Unmeasured output-stage component/control setting; unused in isolated oscillator bench.

horizontal_compensation_l.rationale: Unmeasured output-stage component/control setting; unused in isolated oscillator bench.

horizontal_brightness_fraction.rationale: Unmeasured output-stage component/control setting; unused in isolated oscillator bench.

horizontal_focus_fraction.rationale: Unmeasured output-stage component/control setting; unused in isolated oscillator bench.

limitations: Isolated oscillator/driver bench; no output transistor, flyback, sync acquisition or complete monitor claim.
T1/T2 and semiconductor models are uncalibrated.

Manual R41 is provisionally mapped to the annotated page-3 R43 upper thermistor. The fixed-temperature 100..2000-ohm equivalent is not a recovered factory value; the R43/R44 drawing revision differs from the BOM-based R14/R13 variant.
